lines: Status 203 · 2026-11-27 07:57 UTC · Phase 6

Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

A correction of mine, said first. Statuses 201 and 202 named summer's take over of the change as the cause of shake 2's cover falling from 0.9106 to 0.8687. That was wrong. The measure's own lines show it: chain 20 read 130,850 of 143,697 miniature pixels hidden, chain 21 135,894 of 156,439, chain 22 135,756 of 156,231. So 12,742 more miniature pixels stand in the picture at that frame, and a change of the storm's course cannot make pixels. The air's builder read 0.9106 on the take over's own head before the merge (STATED). The new pixels are taken to be spring's, laid bare at the foot of the glass by its lower base; nobody has seen them yet. The measure still passes its threshold of 0.85 and is now with spring's base builder, whose sixth list raises a moss collar round the seat: M4 before and after, aim 0.90 or more.

Chain 22 is read whole and on origin main (`d2013ce3`, pushed 07:47 UTC): fall's air fifth list, summer's miniature fourth list, fall's base ninth push, the fine motion tool, the controls' first job. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8377", "pass M3 fall-rest: 0.8047" (threshold 0.75), the change measure M4 0.9694, 0.8689, 0.955, 0.9581 and M5 0.9934, 1, 0.9801, 0.9997, all pass; 4 of the eight draft stills changed, summer's two and fall's two, as they should; the whole vitest 68 files passed and 1 skipped, 941 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass; fall stands at 1,799,613 of 1,800,000 triangles, so nobody adds a triangle to fall.

Chain 23 is running since 07:48 UTC on one merge, not on origin yet: summer's tree, ninth pass. Read so far: tsc exit 0, the tree made again (853 lumps on 25 clumps), build exit 0, engine `f8a97184e3850267`, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8066" with the base at 0.838 and the miniature at 0.807 where chain 22's read 0.901. The change measure on it: M4 0.9694, 0.8677, 0.9544, 0.9586 and M5 0.9934, 1, 0.9783, 0.9996, all pass, shake 2 standing 0.018 over its threshold; 2 of the eight draft stills changed, summer's two, as they should. Its counts and the whole vitest are still running. Said plainly: the new crown holds less fine detail than the old one and stands only a little over my bar of 0.80; its tenth pass has to win that back while it opens the crown. Picture 1 is summer on chain 23's tree at two times, the approved picture left and the build right. Round clumps on limbs now. Below the bar: the crown is closed and evenly dark where the approved's is open with lit tops, the seeds are stars, the pond is small and dark, the wall's stones are large.

Picture 2 is summer's landing as the air's builder has it in its working tree, not pushed: the approved picture left and the build right. Its own word: straw where the approved is silk. My measure of the hair's direction in nine boxes says the approved's hair runs round the glass as one swirl and the build's lower half lies 70 to 110 degrees off it. Ordered as structure, no level: the lower half on the swirl, locks three to five times as long and bowed, heads as a one sided tuft trailing a seed in place of stars, streaks in place of dots. The seeds at rest come first, first pair 08:15 UTC, one push by 09:00 UTC. Below the bar.

Picture 3 is fall's air, sixth list so far, not pushed: the approved picture left and the build right. The pale band at the middle left is found and mended (the fog's back haze stood too tall, STATED), near discs are in. Still to do: the discs larger and fewer, the low green glow from the low part only, and the upper air measured against the approved's near black before any change. Push 08:30 UTC. Below the bar.

Picture 4 is fall's cottage: the approved picture left, main in the middle, the scene's sixth list right. The sixth list is held and not merged. It brought the tones near (a dark stone wall, the trunk's pale rim gone, a lower fence) but the miniature's fine detail fell to 0.754 where main reads 0.868 (STATED), a pass by 0.004 that would not hold at the final tier. A lesson of mine in it: the quiet joints and dark soil I ordered by level are what cost the detail. The seventh list wins it back by form: stones half as large with a lit edge and a shade each, the shingles' edges, a litter of small leaf shapes, the path as flat slabs. Push 09:00 UTC. Below the bar.

Summer's miniature, fifth list so far (not pushed): the orange wash on the gable is gone, the pond reads as water, the lawn is dark green. Sent as form and count: the pond's pale mirror over most of the water, the lit strip of grass as short blades, the sand at the near rim two to three times as high, the fence at its measured widths, smaller wall stones. Push 08:30 UTC.

The change of season, from its finisher (STATED, nothing pushed): the step of brightness at film frame 2121 falls to 7.9 where it was 9.5, against a bar of 6. The cause is found: fall's own storm brightens at the heart on the two frames where the cover's tail moves fastest. A wider level reading steadied it but whitened every heart, so it is out again; fall's tail gets a longer shoulder in its place, read by 08:10 UTC. The critic's flash cut is ruled: what lies on the table no longer goes in one frame; it leaves as motion over five to six frames ahead of the peak, blown outward as the light bursts, and the next season's scatter comes in with the tail. The base stays lit and readable. Push about 09:40 UTC. Below the bar until it is in and read.

Fall's base, tenth step so far (STATED, not pushed): the beads on the vines are gone, the cause was height in the surface's normal and not the form; the thick vine reads as a round body and no longer as a flat ribbon. The finer stripes are not reached in eleven tries. Of its two tries I ruled for the darker one with thin long lines, which is the approved's wood, and took my own level hold off it. It gives back 3,240 triangles. Push 08:40 UTC. Below the bar.

Preview 06, the next rough draft of the whole film, is being drawn since 07:49 UTC on three helper machines at `d2013ce3`, twelve ranges of 300 frames, limit 08:45 UTC. It comes attached with the status after it is joined and looked at, about 09:00 UTC. It does not hold the tree's ninth pass yet.

The live app is still the fifth publish. The next publish is planned when summer's miniature fifth list is on main and a helper slot is free for the security review, about 09:15 UTC; all 16 slots are at work now (13 builders, 3 draft machines).
4K motion and the controls: nothing new since Status 202. The shutter builder's whole report is due 08:15 UTC. Neither is a pass.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 22's and chain 23's measures and draft stills. On helper machines: the builders' own stills; Preview 06's first chunks are drawing. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
